versions.changelog: v1.1.0 (initial release, all-English): skill-author — Author, harden, and publish agent skills for ClawHub. Four capabilities: (1) AUTHOR — write ClawHub-conformant skills via references/authoring-guide.md (frontmatter field reference verified against CLI source, slug/naming rules incl. protected namespaces, versioning & tags, file layout & allowed text extensions, license model, description writing, SKILL.md body conventions, security by design); (2) HARBARDEN -> Harden — 10-point pre-publish checklist (registry diff, dead links, doc/code consistency, secrets, artifacts, LICENSE/VERSION); (3) Remediate — 9 audit patterns -> fixes in references/audit-patterns.md, distilled from two real cases (epic-novel-writer 1.2.1 command injection; image-with-comfyui 1.7.1 data egress + supply chain), incl. false-positive handling; (4) Publish & verify — publish with itemized changelog, poll through the pending.publication queue. No hardcoded secrets, no non-loopback endpoints in shipped files.
